title: The Starving Stars
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Astronomer Dr. Lena Voss has spent her career cataloging stars that dim — a slow, regular fading that no model explains. When a colleague\'s research vessel goes dark at the coordinates of the dimmest star, Lena joins the recovery mission and discovers the stars are not fading: they are being fed on, and the feeder is now in our solar system.
